text:
maria_support: Customer says dashboard shows $50 trial credits but their API billing/usage returns 0 and they're being billed. Customer: ACME Inc (org_92). Screenshot attached: https://files.redwood.test/shot.png — can someone triage?

sam_billing: Can you paste the org id and the project id? also, do we have the customer's account email? :eyes:

maria_support: org: org_92, project: proj_zulu, email: kate+acme@example.com. Customer sees `Trial balance: $50` in Console > Billing > Credits. API /v1/billing/usage for the same period returns `0` credits applied and shows charged tokens.

jordan_engineer: Quick checklist: 1) Are they using a dedicated/private deployment or hosted? 2) Are they hitting the hosted API key vs a dedicated endpoint key? 3) Check promo mapping — sometimes promo credits land on org root not the project.

maria_support: Hosted API (api.redwood.com), using regular hosted key. Customer says they used the trial signup flow last week.

sam_billing: Thanks. I pulled org_92. I see a promo grant record created 2026-03-09 with id promo_021 and amount 50. Status = "active" and scope = "org". So console shows it. Metering rows for the project show zero credit adjustments. Could be that the credit application job didn't tag project usage. Will investigate.

jordan_engineer: Two things to quickly repro locally: 1) call billing usage endpoint the customer used:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.com/v1/billing/usage?org=org_92&since=2026-03-09"
```

2) look up invoice adjustments: internal admin api (for support/billing only):

```bash
curl -u admin:REDACTED "https://internal.redwood/admin/credits?org=org_92"
```

(I will not post real admin output here).

ashley_cse: Customer is getting upset — they were charged $3.24 for a test call. Wants a temporary refund if we can't fix within 24h. Can we credit them manually? :thinking:

sam_billing: We can provisionally add a $3.24 adjustment to their account while root cause is fixed, but need CSE approval and audit note. I'll prepare an adjustment and flag for reconciliation.

billing-bot: [automated] Created ticket BILL-8732 for org_92: "Credits visible in dashboard not applied to metering". Assigned to sam_billing.

jordan_engineer: Preliminary root cause hypothesis: credits were granted at org level but the metering pipeline that applies credits to project usage expects a `billing_scope` header or a `project_id` mapping in the allocation table. If the project was created after the promo grant, allocation might be missing. I'll check the allocation table (allocations where org=org_92).

maria_support: I pulled customer's project creation time: 2026-03-11 (after promo created on 2026-03-09). That matches your theory.

sam_billing: OK I see allocation record missing for proj_zulu. I'm going to run the one-off reconcilation script that binds org-level credits to presently existing projects. Command: `POST /internal/jobs/reconcile_credits` with payload {org:org_92, dry_run:false}. Running now in staging path, then will run in prod after review.

jordan_engineer: If you run it, please capture the reconcile-job-id and the output. Also we should include the API request id from the customer's charged call to prove what usage buckets were hit. Maria, can you get the request id from the customer or ask them to run the single failing call with `-v` and paste the `x-redwood-request-id` header?

maria_support: Sent to customer. They returned the header: `req_9a8b7c6d`. Attached the logs.

sam_billing: Running reconcile (prod) now. Job id: rec_4412. Output: 3 allocations created, credits applied to proj_zulu for period 2026-03-09 -> 2026-04-09, amount $50. Reconciliation adj created: adj_552.

billing-bot: [automated] Adjustment adj_552 applied to proj_zulu: +$50. Audit note: applied by sam_billing via rec_4412.

sam_billing: I also reprocessed metering rows for request id req_9a8b7c6d — credits were retroactively applied and invoice updated. Customer should see zero charge for that call.

ashley_cse: I notified the customer that we applied the credit and updated their invoice. Asking if they want any additional steps. :white_check_mark:

jordan_engineer: Follow-up: we'll add a small fix — when creating project after a promo grant, run a post-create hook that picks up unallocated org-level credits. Filed TECH-1251 to add this hook.

maria_support: Great. For the slack thread record: can we close once customer confirms? Also please add a short postmortem note in BILL-8732 about allocation timeline and the reconcile job steps.

sam_billing: Will add notes and keep ticket open until customer confirms. Estimated closure 24-48h.

maria_support: Customer confirmed refund applied and their dashboard billing usage now shows credits applied. Closing on hold until they report any more issues. Thanks team. :heart:
